name: Yea Shin Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Yea Shin Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and trades in wafers and electronic components in Taiwan and internationally. It provides 4-inch and 5-inch TVS, ZENER, LDTVS, FRED, HER, FR, and STD devices. The company's products are used in various end markets, including automotive electronics, 5G, telecommunications, artificial intelligence, industrial control, and data centers. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Keelung, Taiwan. As of July 31, 2018, Yea Shin Technology Co., Ltd is a subsidiary of Eris Technology Corporation.
